about_short_description.short_description: Usul is the modern platform for defense contract capture and federal growth.

product.name: PEO Directory
product.description: A platform providing detailed organizational charts, budget data, competitor tracking, and live contract monitoring for Program Executive Offices (PEOs).

product.name: Contract Inbox
product.description: A personalized daily delivery of contract opportunities matched to user capabilities from multiple government portals.

product.name: Pipeline Management
product.description: A unified workspace for managing capture and business development pipelines with collaboration and task ownership features.

product.name: Competitive Intelligence
product.description: A tool to monitor competitor activity, pricing, contract awards, and corporate structures within defense markets.

product.name: Recompete Tracker
product.description: A system to identify incumbent contracts approaching renewal and provide early alerts for competitive bidding.

identifier.value: Industry Days Calendar and Event Intelligence

product.name: Industry Days Calendar and Event Intelligence
product.description: A calendar and intelligence service providing schedules, speaker directories, and agendas for government industry days and conferences.
